title: Counter check-in
emptyDescription: Try the diver’s name, email, or full booking ID.
emptyQuietDescription: Divers appear here around their departure time.

instrument.cantBoard: {count, plural, one {# diver can’t board yet} other {# divers can’t board yet}}
instrument.notHere: {count, plural, one {# diver is not here} other {# divers are not here}}

row.giftUnclaimed: A gift from {giver}, not claimed yet
row.giftDoor: Seat the giver’s friend by name

noShow.consequence: Records that they did not arrive and frees the seat. You can put them back while the seat is still free.
noShow.sailedConsequence: The boat has gone, so this records that they did not dive. They get no recap and the day will not count for them. You can put them back.
noShow.sailedConfirm: Mark that they did not dive
noShow.undoAriaLabel: Put {name} back on this boat’s list
noShow.waiting: {count, plural, one {# diver is waiting for this seat} other {# divers are waiting for this seat}}
noShow.rebook: Nobody is waiting. Offer {name} another day.
noShow.nothing: Nobody is waiting, and no similar departure has room for them.
noShow.money: Marking someone not here does not charge or refund anything.

identity.message: Is the person at the counter {name}? Only do this once you’ve checked it’s the same person, and not someone else with a similar name or a shared email. Confirming hands that diver’s certifications and waiver to this seat, spends any prepaid dives that cover it, and cannot be undone. If it’s someone else, book them under their own email instead.

sendFailed: That didn’t send. Tap the row again.
offlineLabel: Offline — this board may be out of date
otherDiversDescription: People in the shop record who are not booked on today’s departures

notice.notReady: Readiness changed. <tripLink>Open Trip to resolve the blocker</tripLink>, then try again.
notice.notBookable: That booking is no longer available for check-in.
notice.alreadyCheckedIn: That diver was already checked in.
notice.notFound: That booking could not be found.
notice.staffNotFound: Your staff access could not be confirmed.
notice.invalid: Choose a diver from the queue before checking in.
notice.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver, or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notice.waiverGuardianName: The co-signer’s name is the diver’s own, so this release would show one person signing twice. Type the guardian’s name as their own ID reads it, and if the diver’s record is shorter than the diver’s ID, correct the record to match. If the two really do read exactly alike, tick the confirmation on this form and record it.
notice.waiverIdentityUnconfirmed: This seat is held until somebody confirms who this diver is, so a paper release can’t go on their record yet. Confirm it on their row, then record the release.
notice.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Try again, or open the diver’s trip to see why.
notice.walkinAdded: Added to this boat’s list. Check them in when they arrive.
notice.walkinAddedWaiverUndelivered: Added to this boat’s list, but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Send it or share the link from their row below.
notice.walkinAddedIdentityUnconfirmed: Added to this boat’s list, but the seat is held until you confirm it’s the same person. Confirm it on their row below before they board.
notice.walkinFull: That boat is full. Try the wait list from its trip page instead.
notice.walkinAlready: That diver is already on this boat.
notice.walkinCourseUnstaffed: That’s a course session with no instructor assigned yet. Assign one from its trip page first.
notice.walkinCoursePrerequisite: That course needs verified prerequisite certification this diver doesn’t have on file.
notice.walkinCourseRatioFull: That session is at its instructor-to-student ratio. Add another instructor, or use the wait list.
notice.walkinCourseMinAge: That diver is under the course’s minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on file.
notice.walkinTripPrerequisite: That diver’s certifications don’t reach what this boat and its dive sites require.
notice.walkinUnavailable: That diver can’t take a seat on this boat right now.
notice.walkinInvalid: Choose a boat and enter a name before adding a walk-in.
notice.noShowAlreadyBoarded: The crew boarded that diver, so they can’t be marked as not diving. Open the trip’s manifest.
notice.noShowAlreadyMissingAfterDive: The crew recorded that diver as not back aboard after a dive. Call the boat and open the trip’s manifest.
notice.identityNotHeld: That seat is no longer held. It may already have been confirmed by somebody else.
notice.noShowAlreadyMarked: That diver is already marked not here.
notice.noShowNotBooked: That seat was given up, so there is nothing to mark.
notice.noShowTripCancelled: That departure is cancelled, so its guest list can’t change.
notice.noShowBeforeDeparture: That boat has not left yet, so nobody has missed it. Try again once it departs.
notice.noShowWindowClosed: That departure is too far past for the counter. Change the booking from the trip’s guest list instead.
notice.noShowNotMarked: That diver is not marked not here.
notice.noShowTripFull: The freed seat has already been taken, so that diver cannot go back on this boat.
notice.noShowCourseRatioFull: That session is at its instructor-to-student ratio, so that diver can’t go back on it. Assign another instructor first.

walkIn.title: Walk-in
walkIn.description: No email required at the counter.
walkIn.tripEmpty: No boats sail in the next day and a half.
walkIn.changeTrip: Not this one? Pick a different boat.
walkIn.handEntryDescription: Email is optional, and the crew can collect it later. A name is enough to get them on the boat now.

blockerReasonsWithFirst: {reason} {count, plural, one {And # more reason.} other {And # more reasons.}}
